_instructions.purpose: Graded relevance labels for reviewer-priority ranking (TZ v2 §9.1 nDCG, graded 0/1/2).
workflow: 1. One case per reviewed package/sheet; copy findings with their priority_score from the report (issues[].priority or export).
2. Each adjudicator grades relevance independently (dual-blind), then reconcile: 0 = noise/false positive, 1 = useful remark, 2 = critical must-fix.
3. Set dataset_status=adjudicated ONLY after both experts signed the reconciliation; draft/synthetic results are never product ranking quality (RT-001).
4. Run: python -m aerobim.tools.evaluate_ranking_quality --labels <this file> --output <run>/ranking-report.json (or via run_pilot_harness --ranking-labels).
_instructions.claim_boundary: tie-aware expected nDCG on the labeled corpus only; никогда не публикуется как качество ранжирования продукта без adjudicated customer corpus
